description:
The reference MemoryBackend in every extension-server crate uses runtime O::TYPE_NAME string equality inside generic /set methods (create_object/update_object/destroy_object) to dispatch per-type index-maintenance:

  - crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory.rs: O::TYPE_NAME == 'Mailbox' / 'Email' / 'EmailSubmission' at ~690, 741, 763, 780
  - crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/memory.rs: O::TYPE_NAME == 'CalendarEvent' (was 3 sites, collapsed to one helper in JMAP-ic0j.44; the helper still does the string compare internally)
  - crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs: likely similar
  - Other siblings: not audited

The principled fix is to add a 'fn after_set_hook(...)' default method on the JmapObject foundation trait (jmap-server::JmapObject) that per-type impls override. Dispatch becomes a trait method call rather than a runtime string compare; the compiler can prove which branch is reachable for each O.

Pre-requisites for that fix:
- Change JmapObject in jmap-server (foundation crate).
- Propagate to every type that implements JmapObject across jmap-mail-types, jmap-chat-types, jmap-calendars-types, jmap-tasks-types, jmap-contacts-types, jmap-filenode-types, jmap-metadata-types, jmap-sharing-types.
- Update every extension-server MemoryBackend to use the trait method instead of string equality.
- Pass through every MemoryBackend's tests.

Scope: workspace-foundation change. Filed at P3 because:
- The current pattern works correctly (not a correctness bug).
- The per-extension workaround (collapse to a single private helper) is already in place in calendars-server and is the reviewer's recommended stable workaround.
- The propagation cost is high relative to the code-smell impact.

Reviewer recommendation in the parent: do option (a) at the canonical layer when other reasons drive a JmapObject foundation revision. Don't do it standalone.
title: MemoryBackend runtime O::TYPE_NAME string-equality dispatch — workspace-wide pattern across calendars/mail/chat servers
